{{Quote|Behold, the favorite weapon of Jedi before the invention of the lightsaber.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Tahiri Veila]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>}}
A '''hammer''' was a type of tool<ref name="SWS" /> that was used to push nails or other sharp objects into another object to build wooden structures. Hammers could also be used as blunt weapons and it was considered a very primitive yet useful tool in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Hammers could also be used during military tribunals to call order to the proceedings.<ref name="TH">{{WEGCite|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook|story=The Hearing}}</ref>
